recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Further changes to the nuanced GET/POST plus 405 conformance model should be made only under a new work-group decision, not by restoring the superseded FHIR-31912 wording.
issue_request: FHIR-31912 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked to clarify HTTP search conformance language so it would not be interpreted as requiring both POST and GET; its literal resolution said servers supporting search SHALL support POST and SHOULD support GET.
initial_application: No historical source-changing commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-31912 was found. The ambiguous original HTTP sentence was replaced through later R5 search-method work that introduced current GET/POST plus 405 guidance, moved HTTP-specific transport guidance to source/http.html, and completed companion POST parameter clarifications.
additional_context: FHIR-31943 later made a final Published decision to clarify that servers SHALL support search via GET and POST while using 405 Method Not Allowed when a specific search cannot be processed with the client-supplied method, and editor Zulip follow-up described FHIR-31943 and FHIR-31944 as superseding FHIR-18551 and FHIR-31912. Related reconciliation commits for FHIR-31943, FHIR-31944, FHIR-38994, and FHIR-39137 were already on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current active HTTP and Search pages implement the later search-method model with GET/POST support, 405 behavior, method-choice considerations, POST body/query-parameter handling, and GET-style self links; restoring FHIR-31912's literal wording would conflict with later final decisions.
